prompts.action_icons_prompt.txt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a production game UI sprite atlas, precisely FOUR columns and THREE rows, twelve equally sized cells on a flat pure BLACK #000000 background. Use the attached inventory screenshot only as a reference for friendly handmade fullness; do not copy its layout or text. Each cell contains ONE isolated solid PURE WHITE #ffffff silhouette pictogram, chunky hand-drawn rounded contours, readable at 36 pixels, no outlines, no grey shading, no text, no labels, no border, no tile background. Generous empty black padding inside each cell; icons centered exactly at each cell center and occupy 65 percent of cell. Row 1 left to right: sprout with two plump leaves and three seeds (plant), tilted watering can with three water drops (water), plump gathering hand holding leaves (harvest), diagonal short spade with broad blade (dig). Row 2: open friendly mitten hand (interact), rounded pocket bag with handle (inventory), wooden shipping crate with upward arrow (shipping), crescent moon with small star (sleep). Row 3: small shop awning (shop), plump fish side silhouette (fish), nautical anchor (landing), curved return arrow (back). Exactly these 12 icons, separated cleanly, flat black and solid white only.
prompts.pocket_icons_prompt.txt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create game inventory item sprite atlas exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows on a solid vivid MAGENTA #ff00ff background. Reference the attached cozy pocket inventory screenshot for tactile full-bodied friendly illustrated item quality, but draw original sea-homestead objects, no logos. Each equal-sized cell has one centered item, 62 percent of cell size maximum, empty magenta padding. Softly hand-painted, plump small toy-like items, warm natural colors, restrained soft internal shading, slightly angled three-quarter view. Clean edges, no shadows cast on the magenta background, NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, no labels, no grid lines. Row 1 left to right: bundled two timber logs with growth rings; a worn blue-grey cog and small bolt; a thick tan rope coil; three sea-glass turquoise shards. Row 2: small cream paper seed packet illustrated with a simple green sprout; pink scallop shell; silver-blue fresh fish; full leafy green lettuce head. Row 3: ripe plump red tomato with green leaves; round orange pumpkin; single glowing ivory pearl; cream lettuce seed packet with green lettuce illustration. Row 4: cream tomato seed packet with red tomato illustration; cream pumpkin seed packet with orange pumpkin illustration; blue-grey watering can; three warm golden bottle caps. Separate all 16 objects in their cells. Use only the flat magenta color for background; do not use magenta anywhere on the objects.
